about_the_game:
Explore the frontier lands.

Venture through dusty desert bluffs, snow-capped mountains, and the shadowy ruins of ancient cult hideouts. Battle ruthless outlaws in campaign missions, high-stakes elimination contracts, and relentless wave-based survival challenges. But the outlaws aren’t the only danger—a mysterious cult faction lurks beneath the surface. Unlock new weapons through use in combat, and customize your experience with four selectable difficulty levels.

Choose the weaponry that suits you.

Whether you prefer the accuracy of a rifle, the close-range power of a shotgun, or the speed of sidearms, your weapons shape how you fight. Each class has multiple variants to suit different approaches. From the solid hit of a crossbow to the sheer volume of a Gatling gun, you'll have plenty of hot lead dispensers to choose from. You can even dual-wield sidearms if you want to trade precision for raw firepower.

The outlaws' bullets are fast, but you’re faster.

Use bullet time to line up your shots. Sprint and dash to stay mobile, keeping pressure where it hurts. Swap weapons on the fly to always have the right tool for the job. During a reload, mashing the reload key speeds it up, and every second counts when you’re under fire. You’re equipped for the fight. The rest is up to you.

name: Saloonery

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, any x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Grab your trusty revolver and blast away outlaws in this fast-paced shooter. You'll need to use the wide arsenal of weapons, your razor-sharp reflexes, and an itchy trigger finger to bring order to the lawless western frontier. It's Saloonery time!
